notes: Pipeline proof only; not a benchmark prop. Cube spans X/Y +/-50 mm and Z 0..100 mm. 0.5 mm three-segment edge bevel; one nominal box collider (corner deviation <1 mm). Checker and TEST source is generated with Pillow and packed in source.blend. Albedo is 64-sample CPU Cycles diffuse colour only, multiplied in linear light by mix(1, AO, 0.6), saved as 8-bit sRGB; source retains Principled PBR wear/grime. Generated with Blender 5.2.0 LTS; identity OBJ axes Y forward, Z up. The 100 mm cube is an export test and exceeds the recommended one-hand grasp width. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder.
